text: The Bank of England voted 6-3 to hold Bank Rate at 3.75%, with three MPC members preferring a 25-bp hike. The hold contrasts with recent Fed and ECB increases. U.K. inflation stood at 3.1%, while 10- and 30-year gilt yields fell after the decision.

meta.note: The internal vote split is observable; subsequent rate settings remain unresolved.

text: The SEC's five-year Innovation Exemption permits qualifying venues to offer tokenized U.S. equities under volume limits. Tokens must preserve traditional shareholder rights, while issuers receive a 30-day objection window before tokenized trading begins.

meta.note: The pathway is an interim exemption rather than durable rulemaking; issuer participation remains conditional.
